row: 黃桷灣立交位於重慶南岸區，五層匝道層層相疊，可通往八個方向，最高約 37 公尺，2009 年動工、2017 年 6 月 1 日全面通車。

airspace.zh: 在中國大陸飛行無人機須依民航局（CAAC）規定實名登記，大型水利、交通設施周邊多為禁飛區；重慶市區多為管制空域；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Drones in mainland China must be registered with the CAAC, and large dams and transport works are usually no-fly zones; most of urban Chongqing is controlled airspace. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 五層匝道、八個方向，山城裡的交通結
tagline.en: Five levels, eight directions: a traffic knot in the mountain city

zh: 重慶南岸區，黃桷灣立交。
五層高架匝道層層相疊，可通往八個方向。
en: The Huangjuewan interchange in Nan'an District, Chongqing.
Five levels of ramps are stacked on top of each other, leading in eight directions.

zh: 從正上方看，匝道像一團交錯的緞帶。
2017 年 6 月 1 日全面通車。
en: Seen from straight above, the ramps look like a tangle of ribbons.
It opened fully on 1 June 2017.

zh: 最高一層離地約 37 公尺，
大約十幾層樓高。
en: The top level is about 37 m above the ground,
roughly the height of a twelve-storey building.

zh: 匝道約有 20 條（另有統計為 15 條），
彎道一圈接一圈，在山坡間繞行。
en: There are about 20 ramps (15 by another count),
curving loop after loop between the hillsides.

zh: 重慶是著名的「山城」，平地很少。
道路只能往上疊，才能在有限的谷地裡互相連接。
en: Chongqing is famous as the "mountain city", with very little flat land.
Roads have to be stacked so they can all meet in a narrow valley.

zh: 東側的匝道彼此上下交錯，
車輛在不同高度同時通過，互不干擾。
en: On the east side the ramps cross over and under each other,
so cars at different heights pass at the same moment without meeting.

zh: 沿著南向主線飛進立交。
一路上可以看到上下好幾層的道路。
en: Flying in along the main road from the south.
All the way, roads can be seen on several levels above and below.

zh: 西側的主線往市區方向延伸，
周邊是密集的住宅大樓。
en: On the west side the main road heads toward the city centre,
lined by dense blocks of flats.

zh: 東側的主線則通往城市另一頭，
各方向的車流都在這裡分流與匯合。
en: The main road on the east side heads to the other side of the city;
traffic from every direction splits and merges here.

zh: 因為匝道太複雜，
通車後一度被網友戲稱為「最難走的立交」。
en: Because its ramps are so complicated,
after it opened people online jokingly called it the hardest interchange to drive.

zh: 接下來三部影片，看它的結構、施工與影響。
本片的匝道高度依地圖的層級資料估算。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The next three films look at its structure, its construction and its impact.
Ramp heights in this model are estimated from the layer data of the map.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

title.zh-Hant: 黃桷灣立交：結構與技術

tagline.zh-Hant: 一層一層疊起來的轉向匝道
tagline.en: Turning ramps stacked level upon level

zh: 立交的基本道理：讓交叉的車流分在不同高度，
彼此不用停下來等紅綠燈。
en: The basic idea of an interchange: put crossing streams of traffic at different heights
so none of them has to stop at a traffic light.

zh: 最底層是地面道路與主線，
往上每一層，都是一組轉向的匝道。
en: The lowest level carries the ground roads and main lines;
each level above holds another set of turning ramps.

zh: 第四、第五層位在最上方，
跨越下面所有的道路，需要最長的坡道才能上下。
en: The fourth and fifth levels sit at the top,
crossing every road below and needing the longest slopes to climb and descend.

zh: 迴圈匝道讓車輛轉 270 度，
用一個圓圈完成左轉，不必和對向車流交叉。
en: A loop ramp turns cars through 270 degrees,
making a left turn with a circle instead of crossing oncoming traffic.

zh: 匝道由一根根橋墩撐起，
彎道上的橋面略為傾斜，讓車輛轉彎更穩。
en: The ramps are carried on rows of piers,
and on the curves the deck is tilted slightly so cars turn more steadily.

zh: 從上方看得最清楚：
每一條匝道都只負責一個方向的轉換。
en: From above it is easiest to see:
each ramp handles just one change of direction.

zh: 在山坡地形裡，橋墩高低不一，
同一條匝道的兩端，離地高度可能差很多。
en: On hilly ground the piers come in many heights;
the two ends of one ramp may stand at very different heights above the ground.

zh: 匝道在主線兩側分岔與匯入，
設計上要留足夠的加速與減速距離。
en: Ramps split from and merge into the main road on both sides;
the design must leave enough length to speed up and slow down.

zh: 五層疊在一起，
讓八個方向的車流在一處完成轉換。
en: Five levels stacked together
let traffic from eight directions change course in one place.

zh: 北側主線往遠處延伸，
把立交和城市的快速道路網連在一起。
en: On the north side the main road runs into the distance,
tying the interchange into the city's expressway network.

zh: 層層相疊，是山城交通的解法。
模型中的匝道高度為依地圖層級的估計。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: Stacking level upon level is the mountain city's answer to traffic.
Ramp heights in this model are estimates from the map's layer data.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 八年工程，在車流與山坡之間施工
tagline.en: Eight years of work between traffic and hillsides

zh: 工程從 2009 年 9 月開始，
前後花了大約八年。
en: Work began in September 2009
and took about eight years in all.

zh: 先有地面道路與主線，
畫面示意：上方各層匝道還沒有出現。
en: First come the ground roads and main lines.
Shown here: none of the upper ramps exist yet.

zh: 接著第一層匝道一段段往外延伸，
橋墩先立起，再架上橋面。
en: Next the first level of ramps reaches out section by section:
piers go up first, then the deck is placed on them.

zh: 第二、第三層接著跨過下方的道路，
施工時還要讓底下的車流繼續通行。
en: Then the second and third levels cross over the roads below,
while traffic underneath has to keep moving during the work.

zh: 最後是最上層：
它要跨過所有已經完成的匝道。
en: Last comes the top level:
it has to cross every ramp already built.

zh: 山坡地形讓每一座橋墩的高度都不同，
測量與定位必須非常精準。
en: On the slopes every pier has its own height,
so surveying and setting out had to be very precise.

zh: 彎曲的橋面要依線形逐段施作，
不同層的工程常在同一處上下交疊。
en: Curved decks had to be built segment by segment along their curves,
and work on different levels often overlapped in the same spot.

zh: 周邊道路與城市持續擴張，
立交的設計也要配合未來的車流。
en: The roads and the city around kept growing,
and the design also had to allow for future traffic.

zh: 2017 年 6 月 1 日，五層立交全面通車。
通車後的畫面很快在網路上流傳。
en: On 1 June 2017 the five-level interchange opened in full.
Pictures of it spread quickly online.

zh: 八年的工程，換來一個
讓八個方向在山谷裡互通的節點。
en: Eight years of work produced
a junction that links eight directions in one valley.

zh: 施工順序為示意，
實際工程依現場條件分段進行。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: The building sequence here is illustrative;
the real work was done in stages to suit the site.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

title.zh-Hant: 黃桷灣立交：功能與影響

tagline.zh-Hant: 暢通的車流、迷路的駕駛與魔幻山城
tagline.en: Flowing traffic, lost drivers and the magic mountain city

zh: 立交讓八個方向的車流不必停等，
直接轉向各自的目的地。
en: The interchange lets traffic from eight directions keep moving
and turn straight toward where it is going.

zh: 車流在不同高度同時穿行，
尖峰時段也能保持流動。
en: Streams of cars pass at different heights at the same time,
and keep flowing even at rush hour.

zh: 但對第一次來的駕駛來說，
分岔太多，一不小心就會開錯匝道。
en: But for a first-time driver
there are so many splits that it is easy to take the wrong ramp.

zh: 外國媒體也報導過：
有駕駛形容在這裡「迷路」是常見的事。
en: Foreign media reported it too:
drivers described getting lost here as a common experience.

zh: 導航軟體與清楚的路標，
成為通過立交時最重要的幫手。
en: Navigation apps and clear signs
became the most important help for getting through.

zh: 立交也成了重慶「魔幻山城」的象徵，
吸引遊客專程來拍照。
en: The interchange has become a symbol of Chongqing's "magic mountain city" image,
and visitors come specially to photograph it.

zh: 從空中看，它像一件公共藝術；
從地面看，它是每天運轉的交通設施。
en: From the air it looks like a piece of public art;
from the ground it is a working road system, every day.

zh: 高架道路也帶來噪音與景觀的課題，
周邊社區與道路的關係需要持續調整。
en: Elevated roads also bring noise and change the view;
the relationship with nearby neighbourhoods needs ongoing care.

zh: 在山多地少的城市，
把道路疊起來，是節省土地的一種方法。
en: In a city with many hills and little flat land,
stacking roads is one way to save space.

zh: 黃桷灣立交的四部影片到此結束。
歡迎到「AERO 無人機模擬飛行」親自飛一趟。
本片為電腦擬真重建：結構依公開資料簡化建模，
地形取自公開高程資料，不是實地空拍畫面。
en: This ends the four films on the Huangjuewan interchange.
Come and fly here yourself in the AERO drone flight simulator.
A computer reconstruction: the structures are simplified models built from public data,
and the terrain comes from public elevation data. This is not real drone footage.

sources.title: Drivers bewildered by twisting Chinese interchange (News24 / AFP)
